# FBK Marketing

> FBK Marketing provides done-for-you social media content ("social media fulfillment") so busy business owners and operators stay consistent online without daily production work. FBK writes, formats and publishes posts on a set schedule, with an optional approval step or fully automatic posting, plus activity reporting. FBK Marketing is owned and operated by RAIBRO LLC.

## Key facts
- Service: done-for-you social media content creation and publishing, treated as fulfillment (deliverables, cadence, quality control) rather than strategy meetings.
- How it works: Onboard, Plan, Approve, Publish, Report. Clients can approve posts or choose auto-post.
- Platforms: Facebook, Instagram, Twitter (X), LinkedIn and others, chosen to fit the business.
- Content is tailored to the client's brand voice, services, FAQs, reviews and before/after stories; photos are not required to start.
- Built on CasperPortal infrastructure, so content can connect to CasperPortal workflows such as follow-up, missed-call text-back, review requests, booking and pipeline.
- Home page offer: first 30 days of done-for-you content at no charge (the home page states the regular price as $497/month).
- The service details, pricing explanation, FAQ, customer terms and order form pages describe the full-service social media management plan at $1990/month.
- Billing: month-to-month, no long-term contract; cancel with 30 days' notice before the next billing cycle; payments are non-refundable and partial months are not credited.
- Best fit: busy operators who need consistency, service businesses that sell trust, and local businesses (including Georgetown, MA).
- Service area: United States, delivered remotely.
- Affiliate program: affiliates earn $500 per month for every business they enroll, for as long as the business stays in the program.
- Contact: info@fbkmarketing.com, +1-573-432-5325. Mailing address: 252 Daniel Webster Hwy #1093, Nashua, NH 03060.
